# Feature Request

Propose a new user-visible or system capability.

Suggested title prefix: `feat: ` — Label: `enhancement`

## Problem

Describe the user or system problem this feature solves. (Required)

## Proposal

Describe the feature and its expected behavior. (Required)

## Non-Goals

Name what this work must not include. (Optional)

## Impact

Choose one: (Required)

- Core user flow
- Existing user flow
- Internal system behavior
- Documentation or operator workflow

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] ... (Required)

## Validation Plan

Name the exact test, command, or manual QA action. (Required)

## Risks

Note compatibility, migration, security, or UX risks. (Optional)
